issues.on_page: Gain on disposal of capital assets 19,409; Capital appropriations 13,974,136; Total other revenues, expenses, gains, or losses 13,993,545
issues.issue: Capital appropriations (13,974,136, a third of the year's inflows) are kept out of receipts as other financing. That is defensible under the capital-contributions rule. But the cash flow statement (p5) shows 'Property taxes - Capital Improvement Fund' 4,912,726, so much of this line is probably capital-levy property tax. As recorded, statement property tax receipts are only 216,374. Someone should decide whether it belongs in receipts (property tax / state aid).
Depreciation is a non-cash expense, not capital outlay; there is no depreciation function category. It is already marked review.
